target_evaluation_period.description: Main validation period (steps 37-40). Development period (steps 33-36) and test period (steps 41-49) strictly excluded.

all_nodes_in_validation_graph.description: Entire 2-hop snapshot containing historical transactions (steps 1-32) plus validation transactions (steps 33-40).

val_mask_nodes.description: Labelled evaluation universe restricted strictly to validation time steps 33-40.

graph_time_step_ranges.historical_test_period_disclosure: Test time steps 41-49 are completely absent from validation_graph.pt. The test period was previously inspected in a one-time held-out evaluation on 2026-09-25. No test data is touched or re-evaluated.

etgnn.description: Temporal ETGNN with sinusoidal time encodings

matched_gat.description: Aligned no-time baseline GAT with zero vector encodings

primary_contrast.name: Random-Adjusted Advantage Difference
primary_contrast.role: Primary inferential test of between-model explanation fidelity, isolating targeted attribution above baseline model-specific perturbation noise floor.

secondary_diagnostic_contrast.name: Raw Shared-Deletion Response Difference
secondary_diagnostic_contrast.role: Direct sensitivity diagnostic examining raw physical probability drop under identical message-passing edge loss without baseline adjustment.

c1_sample_register.description: 240 unique transactions from the primary ETGNN matched pairs evaluated in Contrast 1.

execution_node_union.description: Exact union of unique transactions across C1, both models primary C2 registers, and both models degree-sensitivity registers. Computes explainers and random draws once per node while preserving separate analysis samples.

uncertainty_analysis_plan.within_node_aggregation_rule: Explainer seeds [42, 43, 44] and random draws [1..30] are within-node repetitions and are aggregated to scalar node advantages before any pair differencing.
uncertainty_analysis_plan.graph_dependence_limitation: Transactions within validation time steps reside in a connected financial graph. The pair cluster bootstrap accounts for matched pairing variance, but does not fully eliminate network autocorrelation among adjacent computation subgraphs. Results are interpreted as transductive finite-sample differences.

precision_planning.precision_formulation: MDES presented strictly as a function of the unknown population standard deviation s_Delta (MDES = c * s_Delta). No absolute MDES claim is made prior to experimental measurement.
